facts.fact: 晨间露台上 Chez 与国王对弈，他自称正在赢棋
facts.anchor: “You’re just mad I’m winning,” Chez mewled.

facts.fact: 国王当着 Chez 的面直白宣布两人接吻了、现在气氛变得很怪
Chez 汇报情报：村民服从的那个权威人物目标不明、真名不详，从头到尾只被称作 general
facts.anchor: He has only ever been referred to as the ‘general’.

facts.fact: 她回答在此从未见过那样的人，且仍不记得自己来到 Wünder 之前的任何生活
facts.anchor: I’ve never met anyone like that here. And I still don’t remember anything about my life before I arrived in Wünder.

facts.fact: 谈到通往钟楼的退路时，她在心里把那座钟楼认作「我们的」而非「我的」
facts.anchor: Technically, it was our clock tower.

facts.fact: 国王声称 Cindervale 的那些人并不无辜——是该王国背叛了他的家族
facts.anchor: Those people were not innocent. Cindervale betrayed my family.

facts.fact: 国王透露曾有一次投票：对方逼迫他妥协、谈判，他对「妥协」一词满心憎恶
facts.anchor: “There was a vote. They demanded that I compromise, that I negotiate.” His lips curled with hatred for the word.

facts.fact: Hatter 后门外的机器与泪河、Emberstead 见过的 maelstrom machine 同类，但大约大五倍
facts.anchor: It was a maelstrom machine just like the ones we’d seen at the River of Tears and at Emberstead. Except this one was about five times the size.
